name: Caesar Breadcrumbs

instructions.primary_message: In a medium nonstick skillet, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add anchovy paste and grated garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add breadcrumbs and, using a flexible spatula, toss to coat. Cook, stirring constantly, until breadcrumbs are golden brown, about 3 minutes. Off heat, stir in lemon zest and Parmigiano-Reggiano. Transfer to a bowl and let cool completely before serving or store in an airtight container at room temperature.

description: Inspired by classic Caesar salad, these breadcrumbs get their savory kick from anchovy paste, grated fresh garlic, and Parmesan cheese. Plus: They take less than 10 minutes to prep and come together in one pan.
notes:
Optional substitutions: anchovy paste → 3 anchovy fillets

Make-ahead and storage: Once completely cooled, the breadcrumbs can be transferred to an airtight container and refrigerated for up to 3 days. The breadcrumbs can be frozen in an airtight container for up to 1 month.
author: Genevieve Yam
